data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 and SRC_001 are compatible with each other but jointly contradict SRC_002: both attempt the constant-difference shortcut (SRC_003 internally catches the error mid-derivation, SRC_001 commits to 33 as the answer), and both share the mechanistic error of equating 4 mod 7 with -2 mod 7 when it is actually -3 mod 7. Their compatibility lies in the shared (flawed) heuristic; their contradiction with SRC_002 is that SRC_002's CRT derivation produces n≡18 mod 35, which excludes 33 entirely (33 mod 35 ≠ 18). The causal mechanism driving the contradiction is the miscomputation of the mod-7 residue offset: -3≠-2, so the unified-residue assumption shared by SRC_001 and SRC_003 generates a different residue class than the algebraic CRT. REFUTED IF: 4≡-2 mod 7 (false: 4≠5), or if 33∈{18+35k: k∈ℤ} (false: 33-18=15 is not divisible by 35), or if SRC_003's self-correction actually arrives at 18 via the shortcut rather than abandoning it.
